== Summary ==
The Players Committee's 2003 errata wording of [[Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core]] and [[Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core (Dark)]] (one entry for both cards) as printed in the Rules Supplement. Image for [[Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core (PC Errata 2003)]] and [[Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core (Dark) (PC Errata 2003)]].

Source: Players Committee, Star Wars CCG Rules Supplement, updated 27 January 2003 ([[Media:SWCCG-Rules-Supplement-2003.pdf|wiki copy]]; [https://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGRules01-27-03.pdf theforce.net]), PDF page 1, entry Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the entry.
